exposure: Percentage of MOM and DM in enteral feeds
outcome: Abundance of specific bacteria (Bifidobacterium, Bacteroides, Staphylococcus)
cohort: The study included 125 very-low-birth-weight (VLBW) infants born at Texas Children's Hospital.
finding: Compared with donor milk-fed infants, mothers' own milk (MOM)-fed infants showed increased gut microbial community diversity, improved feeding tolerance, and superior growth.
